mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_TRADE_CALENDAR T USING ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{tradeDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRADE_DT, #{mktCd} AS MKT_CD, #{tradeYn} AS TRADE_YN FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.TRADE_DT = S.TRADE_DT AND T.MKT_CD = S.MKT_CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.TRADE_YN = S.TRADE_YN WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TRADE_DT, MKT_CD, TRADE_YN, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( S.TRADE_DT, S.MKT_CD, S.TRADE_YN, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(TRADE_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TB_TRADE_CALENDAR WHERE MKT_CD = #{mktCd} AND TRADE_YN = 'Y' AND TRADE_DT <= TO_DATE(#{inputBaseDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRADE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM ( SELECT TRADE_DT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TRADE_DT ASC) - 1 AS RN FROM TB_TRADE_CALENDAR WHERE MKT_CD = #{mktCd} AND TRADE_YN = 'Y' AND TRADE_DT >= TO_DATE(#{baseDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) WHERE RN = TO_NUMBER(#{offset})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TRADE_CALENDAR WHERE MKT_CD = #{mktCd} AND TRADE_YN = 'Y' AND TRADE_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fromDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{toDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRADE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TB_TRADE_CALENDAR WHERE MKT_CD = #{mktCd} AND TRADE_YN = 'Y' AND TRADE_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{fromDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{toDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY TRADE_DT ASC
